prompt: After cancelling a placed order, the available quantity of its products does not come back. Steps: receive 20 mugs into bin A-01-01 and 10 desk lamps into bin A-02-03; create an order for 3 mugs and 1 lamp and place it. Available now shows 17 mugs and 9 lamps, which is right. Cancel the order: available still shows 17 mugs and 9 lamps. The cancelled order holds no reservation any more, so we expected 20 mugs and 10 lamps. If we then receive 1 more mug, available jumps to 21, so the stock itself is fine; only the number shown after the cancel is stale. Fix it and keep the existing tests passing (python -m unittest discover -s tests).
